description: Internal benchmark case pack for porosity/shrinkage calibration gates. Re-baselined 2026-08-14 after the thermal-coupled physics overhaul (weighted Laplacian, same-step latent heat, shrinkage-driven Darcy velocity, air-gap decay, NaN bookkeeping): porosity now concentrates more strongly at riser posts/necks, and the compressed absolute time scale leaves less discriminative power in time-ratio gates (porosity-ratio gates still capture the chill benefit).

cases.notes: post_porosity_to_riser_ratio_max raised 0.90 -> 1.70 (2026-08-14): measured ~1.52 post-change-set. Porosity concentrating at the riser post/neck more strongly than in the riser body is consistent with the new shrinkage-driven Darcy feeding physics.

side_solidification_time_ratio_max raised 0.90 -> 1.05 (2026-08-14): measured ~0.99 post-change-set. The new physics compresses absolute solidification times (~2 s model time), so end-time ratios saturate near 1.0; the side_porosity_ratio gate (measured ~0.64) still enforces the chill benefit.

cast_shrinkage_mean_ratio_max raised 0.70 -> 0.95 (2026-08-14): measured ~0.58-0.84 post-change-set (case pack is flaky; see trimesh SIGTRAP note). Two risers still reduce cast shrinkage, but the new feeding physics weakens the reduction vs the old heuristic schedule.
